title: PPIA-16 Integrated Screen / Workflow Traceability Package Index
gates: All 12 Foundation workflows are represented once and retain their exact P16-WF-001..012 identities.
All 10 screen contracts, 8 action contracts, 8 component contracts, 10 DT tools, 10 AIOC control surfaces, 16 program requirements, 5 authority layers and 12 handoffs have no orphaned coverage.

All 48 Screen/Action predecessor reference cases are assigned exactly once to their owning Foundation workflow; 12 new integrated cases are assigned exactly once, yielding 60 effective PPIA-16 QA cases without redefining predecessor cases.

Authority precedence, raw tool/lifecycle semantics, exact candidate binding, producer receipt digests, stop conditions, historical/current finding distinction and nonactivation boundaries survive every screen handoff.
Candidate-bound evidence becomes stale/historical on candidate change and is never silently reused.
Ambiguous mutation status freezes blind retry and requires owning operation/repository status lookup before retry.
Generated aids, tool PASS, traceability PROVEN, all-green CI, reference probes and synthetic UI tool tests never become broader authority or lifecycle completion.
Dedicated hosted validation plus every applicable exact-head regression must pass on one pull-request head before merge.
completion_effect: Intermediate PPIA-16 milestone only. This package does not by itself complete PPIA-16.
